visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a top-down close-up of a large, beige-colored multi-compartment jewelry organizer tray. It is densely packed with numerous pairs of earrings, including pearls, gold hoops, and designer logo studs. A person's hand with manicured nails briefly points at the collection. The tray sits on a dark brown wooden surface under bright, even indoor lighting. (2) The shot shifts to show a person wearing a light gray t-shirt with black text that includes the word 'Maison'. They are standing at a wooden table and have rolled out a large sheet of clear, industrial-sized plastic wrap. The jewelry tray is placed in the center of the plastic sheet. (3) The individual pulls the large roll of plastic wrap over the top of the tray. Their hands are seen smoothing the film tightly across the surface to secure the items in their respective slots. The background is a slightly blurred indoor home environment. (4) The tray is shown completely sealed, and the person lifts it vertically to demonstrate how the plastic tension prevents the jewelry from moving. The light reflects off the glossy surface of the tightly wrapped plastic. (5) The sealed tray is then placed into a large black bag or suitcase, illustrating a preparation for travel or moving. The camera is handheld, following the movement closely. (6) The final scene transitions to a white dresser drawer being opened, revealing a grid organizer filled with colorful accessories, including large fabric flowers in white, yellow, and blue. The camera pans across the organized compartments, showing a neat storage solution.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video demonstrates a life hack for safely packing large jewelry organizers when moving house. By sealing the entire tray with clear plastic wrap, the user ensures that small earrings and accessories stay in their compartments during transit.
